items.a: A tenant-side rental desk: an agent you hire to find and secure a home in a European city, paid by you only, never by the landlord or their agent. Each desk has its own page, its local checks and three flat fares.

items.q: Which cities have a BOOM desk?
items.a: {cities}. In Rome, BOOM is the agency itself, with homes to rent.

items.q: Do the fares change from city to city?
items.a: No. The same three fares at every desk, VAT included, paid by card on the desk's page; the {gbpDesks} desk charges the same figures in pounds.
{person}, on WhatsApp from each desk's page, or by email: {hours}. A reply comes the same working day.

items.q: Is BOOM {homeCity} a real estate agency?
items.a: Yes. BOOM {homeCity} is a desk of {legalName}, an Italian real estate agency registered in Rome (REA {rea}), under the same Italian law as BOOM Rome. It works for the tenant only: you hire and pay it, never the landlord.

items.q: Can I pay on this page?
items.a: No. Each desk takes its orders on its own page, with the 14-day right of withdrawal and the model form. Every desk starts with a free call, and nothing is charged for it.
